customer_message.subject: chat – landlord says she'll end our lease
customer_message.body:
Ibrahim Achterberg: Hello, my wife and I rent a 4-room flat at Bergstrasse 78 in Steffisburg from Mrs Ruth Messerli. it's our family home, married, two kids
Ibrahim Achterberg: Mrs Messerli told us on the stairs that she's selling the house and wants us out by end of April. nothing written has come so far
Ibrahim Achterberg: I'm sure this is because we complained to the town about the illegal attic conversion next door that she was renting out. she was furious with us. this is payback, not the sale
Ibrahim Achterberg: what can we do before she sends anything?
